# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `greenlandai` MCP server pointing at Greenland AI's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.greenlandai.ai/mcp`).
- Auth uses a Greenland AI API key supplied by the user as an `X-API-Key` header (`${GREENLANDAI_API_KEY}`).
